method: Historical recession-defense screen using annual MarketScope adjusted returns
notes: Annual stress years are used only when a stock has a genuine annual return for that year. This is a historical resilience screen, not a guarantee of future recession performance. The Top 100 is diversity-constrained so no ticker appears more than five times in either the Rebalanced or Not Rebalanced ranking.
portfolio_constraint: Exactly 4 stocks from 4 different sectors: 2 Profit Engines + 2 Recession Defense stocks.
selection_method: Profit-ranked diversified Top 100; each ticker can appear in at most five selected combinations per strategy.
